keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «마을 이장이 윤 박사의 경고를 믿지 않았다(문제)» 와 «과학을 믿은 것이 옳았다(교훈)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the village leader did not believe Dr. Yoon) and the lesson (it was right to trust the science). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Dr. Yoon, the village leader, the families
The leader did not believe that the volcano would erupt.
Dr. Yoon showed her data, and everyone left in time.

words: Dr. Yoon was a scientist who studied volcanoes.
mountains that can send out fire and hot rock

to suddenly explode and send out fire and ash

to be safe if something happens

qs.q: Why was nobody hurt when the volcano erupted?
qs.qko: 화산이 폭발했을 때 왜 아무도 다치지 않았나요?
opts: Everyone had left the village in time.
The volcano was too small to hurt anyone.
evs: Because everyone had left in time, nobody was hurt.
For many years, the volcano was quiet.
Dr. Yoon did not give up.
She lived in a small village near a big mountain called Mount Fira.
why: 모두가 제때 마을을 떠나서 아무도 다치지 않았다고 나와 있어요. 집 안에 숨었다는 말은 없고, 마을은 비어 있었어요.
The text says nobody was hurt because everyone had left in time. Nobody hid in their houses. The village was empty.

qs.q: Dr. Yoon asked the families to leave "just in case." What does "just in case" mean here?
qs.qko: 윤 박사는 가족들에게 "just in case" 떠나 달라고 했어요. 여기서 "just in case"는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: to be safe, because the volcano might erupt
because the village was too crowded
only for one hour, just for fun
evs: For many years, the volcano was quiet.
"The volcano may erupt soon," she told the village leader.
Hot lava flowed down toward the empty village.
Dr. Yoon was a scientist who studied volcanoes.
why: 윤 박사는 «화산이 곧 폭발할지도 몰라요» 라고 했어요. 확실하지는 않아도 혹시 모를 위험에 대비해 안전하게 떠나라는 뜻이에요.
Dr. Yoon said the volcano «may erupt soon». She was not sure, but leaving was the safe choice in case it happened.

qs.q: How did Dr. Yoon know the volcano might erupt?
qs.qko: 윤 박사는 화산이 폭발할지도 모른다는 것을 어떻게 알았나요?
opts: Her machines showed small earthquakes, and the ground was getting warmer.
The village leader told her it would erupt.
She saw a cloud of ash a week before.
evs: But one week, her machines showed small earthquakes every day.
But he did not believe her. "It has been quiet for a hundred years," he said.
The ground near the top was also getting warmer.
Two days later, a huge cloud of ash burst from the mountain!
why: 윤 박사의 기계에 매일 작은 지진이 나타났고, 산꼭대기 근처 땅도 점점 따뜻해졌어요. 이 두 단서를 이어서 폭발을 미리 알았어요.
Her machines showed small earthquakes every day, and the ground near the top was getting warmer. She put these two clues together.

ends: Dr. Yoon teaches the village kids how to read her machines.
윤 박사가 마을 아이들에게 기계 읽는 법을 가르쳐 줘요.
The village builds a new, safer home far from the volcano.
마을 사람들이 화산에서 멀리 떨어진 곳에 더 안전한 새 마을을 지어요.

write.src: “We should <u>listen to scientists</u> so that <u>we stay safe</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «해야 할 일 + 그 목적» 으로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do and its purpose in English.

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «so that» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을 한다» 를 쓰세요. (예: so that everyone is safe)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «so that», write who + what happens. (e.g. so that everyone is safe)

img.cover: On a safe green hill far away, a woman with a short gray bob and round glasses in an orange vest over a white lab coat stands with a tall man with a white beard in a brown hat and many families with backpacks, and they all watch a huge gray cloud of ash burst from a big mountain while glowing orange lava flows down toward a small empty village of red-roofed houses.

scenes.1: In a small wooden lab at the foot of a big quiet mountain, a woman with a short gray bob and round glasses in an orange vest over a white lab coat leans close to a machine whose screen shows a jumpy zigzag line, while a cup of tea on the table shakes a little.
scenes.2: In the middle of a small village with red-roofed houses, a woman with a short gray bob and round glasses in an orange vest over a white lab coat holds up a big chart full of zigzag lines to a tall man with a white beard in a brown hat, who looks at it with wide eyes, while families with backpacks and suitcases walk away down the road.
